content:
Hiro (Capacity): Heads-up: were opening a controlled soft-launch for the Cobalt X100 dedicated pools next week. Regions: AMS-2 (eu-west-ams) and IAD-3 (us-east-ash). Summary below.
OpsBot: Maintenance window scheduled: 2026-06-07 03:00-05:00 UTC for kernel preload + telemetry hooks.
Hiro (Capacity): Quick overview: Cobalt X100 targets long-context inference and large-batch reranks. Expect ~2.0x throughput vs our current L-class instances for long sequences and better stability on kv-cache heavy workloads.
Nina (Product): Trial pricing and reservation policy?
Hiro (Capacity): Trial pricing: burst $2.50/hr, reserved trial $3.20/hr per GPU (intro only). Min reservation: 2 GPUs; max per-customer trial cap: 128 GPUs. No SLA change during soft-launch.
Eng Runtime: Runtime notes: enable `--kv-cache=on`, set `--prefetch-kernels cobalt_fast`, and use `max_batch_size=48` for throughput testing. Watch for warmup cold-starts on first 30 mins.
Infra Oncall: Critical: were disabling cross-zone live-migration for Cobalt during trial. If you rely on live-migration fallback, add explicit fallback pools in routing. If you see `cobalt-mig` errors, page infra.
Sales Ops: Migration guidance for customers on older reserved pools?
Hiro (Capacity): Recommended path: 1) Run 1-2 hour canaries with 5-10% traffic. 2) Monitor p50/p99 and error-rate; have routing fallback to current reserved pools (label: stable-dedicated). 3) Use tag `cobalt-trial` for billing + telemetry.
Nina (Product): Please provide a short blurb for docs and support templates.
Hiro (Capacity): Blurb: "Cobalt X100 (beta): high-throughput dedicated GPUs for long-context LLM inference and batch reranks. Beta pricing and limited windows apply. Sign up via Support."
OpsBot: Quotas: auto quota bumps for customers with `cobalt-trial` tag. Expect confirmation email within 2 business hours of reservation creation.
Eng Runtime: Action: we will validate top 8 customer models on Cobalt kernels by Wed EOD. If you need a test reservation, ping me.
Hiro (Capacity): Action-items: @Sales Ops  reach out to flagged prospects in AMS/IAD. @Support  draft FAQ. @Eng Runtime  post perf artifacts to shared drive. React with :rocket: when owners assigned. Keeping thread for live updates during the soft-launch.
